title: window.INTA
description: Configuration for Intastellar Consents. Set this object on window before loading https://consents.cdn.intastellarsolutions.com/uc.js. Additional vendor-specific keys may exist; unknown properties are allowed.

policy_link.description: URL of your privacy policy (HTTPS recommended).

settings.description: UI and behaviour settings consumed by the banner script.

company.description: Organisation or product name shown in the banner.

color.description: Primary UI colour (typically CSS hex, e.g. #000000).

logo.description: Absolute URL to a logo image.

gtagId.description: Google tag / GA4 measurement ID when using Google integration.

privacy_policy.description: Privacy policy URL; often used together with or instead of policy_link.

requiredCookies.description: Cookie names treated as strictly necessary.

keepInLocalStorage.description: localStorage keys to preserve across consent flows.
